_comment: moderner line, MC 26.1.2 (unobfuscated). jei version is jei_unobfuscated_version in moderner/gradle.properties. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/moderner-26.1.2-neoforge, an independent Gradle build in this repository — the moderner checkout's 1.21.10 engine copy ported to MC 26.1.2) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test: jt resolves and pins, reuses/builds the JECh jar from the moderner checkout's neoforge-unobfuscated module and compiles the harness build, then launches that build's runClientTests with the jars under test as -PjechJar/-PjeiJar. The client drives its own scenarios and writes report.json before it quits itself, so the row declares no ready_when (stopping this client early would kill it mid-scenario) and no world (the level asserted against is the one the harness's runner creates and pins itself, so the JEI plugin marker still arrives). jech and jei both carry via=dev-classpath: the standalone build loads every jar itself — the JECh jar and the pinned JEI jar ride the run's legacy classpath (localRuntime), FML unpacking the jar's embedded PinIn and coremod — so there is nothing for jt to stage, and a staged copy would double-load.
name: moderner-26.1.2-neoforge
